retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century collage style featuring a portrait of a man in a fedora holding a paisley-patterned bag filled with colorful, typographically diverse rectangular blocks.
triggerTerms: paisley bag illustration with text blocks

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned composition where a man in a straw fedora and light jacket holds a green paisley bag in his palm. The bag is overflowing with stylized, colorful rectangular packages, each featuring unique hand-drawn or modified-font typography. The background is a solid muted brown, and the top header features bold, condensed blue lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's hand acts as the physical support for the central illustrated bag.
The bag's paisley pattern provides a complex texture against the flat background.
The colorful blocks inside the bag create a vibrant vertical stack that leads the eye to the top header.
The man's gaze is directed slightly off-camera, balancing the heavy visual weight of the bag on the left.
coreInvariants: The central bag must feature a dense paisley or ornate organic pattern.
The man must be wearing a classic mid-century fedora.
Typography must be eclectic, using multiple colors and styles within the same frame.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The man is positioned on the right third, while the bag and its contents occupy the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's hand at the bottom left of the bag serves as the primary anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the man's face, moves down to the hand, follows the bag upward through the colorful blocks, and ends at the top title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Muted brown negative space surrounds the central figures, providing breathing room for the dense typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted brown background and tan jacket provide a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant green, pink, yellow, and blue in the bag and blocks provide high-energy contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright cyan blue for the main title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central illustration against low saturation in the background and portrait.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-first colors; stick to 1960s print-ink tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of condensed sans-serifs and decorative scripts.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy use of condensed, blocky forms for titles.
Hand-drawn quality with slight irregularities in stroke width.
Text often follows the perspective or shape of the object it is placed on.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the bag are often outlined or given a 'bouncy' baseline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Eclectic mix of contrasting weights and styles to simulate a collection of different show posters.

preserve: The condensed nature of the top title
The variety of colors for different text elements

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of the main title.
Matches the soft, rounded 60s feel of some secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a 1960s straw fedora and tan jacket, holding his hand out flat. In his hand is a green paisley-patterned bag filled with various blank, colorful rectangular boxes against a solid brown background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add condensed blue title text at the top right. Add various stylized, colorful text labels to each of the rectangular boxes and across the surface of the paisley bag using a mix of retro fonts.

verificationChecks: Is the paisley pattern visible on the bag?
Are the text blocks varied in color and font style?
Is the man's fedora a straw-texture style?
Is the background a consistent muted brown?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the internal blocks
mustRedesign: The exact face of the celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text on the bag follows the curves of the fabric.
Check that the man's hand looks like it is naturally supporting the weight.
Verify that the top title is the most prominent typographic element.
Confirm the paisley pattern is intricate and not just a simple dot pattern.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a mid-century portrait with a collage of illustrated objects that serve as containers for diverse, colorful typography.
